runs.rationale_summary: The agent read the 87.5-vs-112.5 failure (call 9) and inferred correctly that the sign was reversed. It then blamed drift because 'drift computes dx and dy as point1 minus point2', and ranked shift 6th as 'a lower-probability direct callee' that 'adds the supplied deltas', even though it had read shift's body at call 18. It took the delta-adding convention as correct without checking it.

The evidence chain says drift 'computes dx and dy as unexploded-point minus exploded-point; the expected values require exploded-point minus unexploded-point'. The agent submitted right after finding the odd-looking subtraction. It grepped only the declaration line of ShapeUtilities.shift (call 16) and never displayed its body, yet still listed it in the chain at rank 6.

The agent displayed shift's full body (grep -A30 at call 18), but judged that 'Plot.nudge only scales ... and ShapeUtilities.shift adds it ... their observed operations are internally consistent'. It blamed drift's 'point1 - point2' as 'the most specific arithmetic cause'. It never displayed the observed failure value: it worked out 112.5 by hand from the expected values in the test source.

The agent traversed the full dispatch chain and read overlay (call 40). A Python probe (call 42) reproduced the observed and expected values, and the agent cited NarrowFolding's 'i * width + at' idiom as corroboration. E4 states that overlay 'contains the most specific arithmetic defect explaining the failure', yet the agent ranked the facade first as 'the tested conversion method'.

The family reports log this arm's stalls as provider events, two of them with connection resets.

pattern: Of the 14 runs in this share, 10 are not localization failures. They are model-response stalls. In each, 2-9 model calls completed at normal cadence, the last trajectory message is a tool output, and no further model response came until SIGTERM, at 300-2571 s. Every one used at most 27 of the 50 allowed tool calls. In 7 of the 10 the gold body had already been displayed: CONVERSION-TREATMENT-01 r002, HA-LOW-01 r003, MATH-NORM-CONTROL-01 r001/r003/r005 and MATH-NORM-TREATMENT-01 r003/r005. These should be excluded as infrastructure. The 4 real misrankings are attribution failures in multi-hop chains, never search failures. (1) In all 3 CHART-PIE-TREATMENT-03 runs the agent used the test values correctly to diagnose a sign reversal. It then blamed the vector definer PlotUtilities.drift, whose correct 'point1 - point2' reads as backwards, over the consumer ShapeUtilities.shift, whose delta-adding body looks 'internally consistent'; shift landed at rank 6. Two runs read shift's body and dismissed it; run-003 never opened it. This is local-oddness bias plus an unverified convention prior, in a chain where no code evidence separates the definer from the consumer. (2) In CONVERSION-BRANCH-TREATMENT-01 r004 the agent explicitly named overlay as 'the most specific arithmetic defect' (confirmed by a Python probe and the NarrowFolding idiom) but still put the directly tested facade first. That is entry-point bias, not missing evidence.
